 Approve command                                     9 lines
rsync -a --delete src/ dst/

what it does
Copies the contents of src/ into dst/, preserving
permissions, timestamps and symlinks, and deletes anything
already in dst/ that is not in src/.

The deletion is the part worth reading twice: dst/ is made
to match src/ rather than added to.
